name: Day 15 — 颱風過後 After the Typhoon

qs.q: Why is fruit expensive?
How much are bananas?
What do they buy?

gram.d: 太 + adjective + 了 = excessively so: 太貴了 too expensive, 太好了 fantastic, 太慢了 too slow. The 了 completes the pattern — market bargaining runs on 太貴了啦!

qs.q: What happened at the office entrance?
ch: A tree fell and there was trash everywhere

qs.q: Who sweeps the floor?
What was broken?

gram.d: 又 + state + 了 = returned to how it was: 公司又乾淨了 the office is clean again, 他又遲到了 he's late again. 又 looks back at a repeat; 再 looks forward to one — 再來一次 = one more time (future).

readings.title: 故事②：路口的牆 Story ②: The Wall at the Intersection

qs.q: Why did the narrator go back to the intersection?
What was at the intersection?
What does the auntie reveal?
ch: Others also claim to have eaten there on the worst typhoon nights

gram.d: 原來 marks the moment of realization: 原來你也看到了 so you saw it too, 原來是你！ so it was YOU! It reframes what you just learned — the storytelling word for every plot twist.

readings.title: 接待演練 The Reception Run-Through

qs.q: Why is today's rehearsal happening?
ch: To make tomorrow's tour process go smoothly

qs.q: What is Xiaomei in charge of?
ch: Reception — greeting the VIPs at the entrance

qs.q: What is the confirmed tour order?
ch: Factory first, then the drone flight demo

gram.d: 為了 + goal fronts the purpose: 為了讓流程順利，我們先演練一次。 For the sake of smooth process, we rehearse first. Business writing leads with 為了 constantly — state the why, then the what.

readings.title: 復工與菜價 Recovery and Vegetable Prices

qs.q: What happened at most industrial zones today?
What is the preliminary estimate of agricultural losses?
What does the government promise?
ch: Faster emergency repairs and rebuilding to normalize prices

gram.t: 隨著…，… — as X happens, Y follows
gram.d: 隨著 + change, main clause = the consequence: 隨著供應減少，菜價上漲。 As supply falls, prices rise. The news-analysis connector for linked trends — pair it with 上漲/下降 and you can narrate any chart.

dict.zh: 颱風過了，天氣很好。
dict.py: Táifēng guò le, tiānqì hěn hǎo.
dict.en: The typhoon passed — the weather is great.

dict.zh: 我們去市場買水果吧。
dict.py: Wǒmen qù shìchǎng mǎi shuǐguǒ ba.
dict.en: Let's go to the market to buy fruit.

dict.zh: 香蕉太貴了！
dict.py: Xiāngjiāo tài guì le!
dict.en: Bananas are too expensive!

dict.zh: 西瓜一個兩百塊。
dict.py: Xīguā yí ge liǎngbǎi kuài.
dict.en: Watermelons are two hundred dollars each.

dict.zh: 芒果比較便宜，買芒果吧。
dict.py: Mángguǒ bǐjiào piányí, mǎi mángguǒ ba.
dict.en: Mangoes are cheaper — let's get mangoes.

pass.zh: 老公，市場的水果都好貴！香蕉一斤八十塊，我沒有買。我買了三個芒果，晚上做芒果冰給你吃，好不好？

qs.q: Why didn't she buy bananas?
ch: Too expensive — eighty dollars a catty

qs.q: What will she make tonight?

dict.zh: 門口有一棵樹倒了。
dict.py: Ménkǒu yǒu yì kē shù dǎo le.
dict.en: A tree fell at the entrance.

dict.zh: 地上都是垃圾。
dict.py: Dìshàng dōu shì lèsè.
dict.en: There's trash all over the ground.

dict.zh: 我們一起打掃吧！
dict.py: Wǒmen yìqǐ dǎsǎo ba!
dict.en: Let's clean up together!

dict.zh: 你掃地，我收拾桌子。
dict.py: Nǐ sǎodì, wǒ shōushí zhuōzi.
dict.en: You sweep; I'll tidy the desks.

dict.zh: 窗戶破了，要請師傅來修。
dict.py: Chuānghù pò le, yào qǐng shīfù lái xiū.
dict.en: The window's broken — we need a repairman.

pass.zh: 各位同事早安！今天上午大家先一起打掃辦公室，下午再開始工作。倒下來的樹，下午會有人來處理，大家不要自己搬，很危險！

qs.q: What's the plan for the morning?
What's the warning about the fallen tree?
ch: Don't move it yourselves — it's dangerous

dict.zh: 我們這棟樓還在停水。
dict.py: Wǒmen zhè dòng lóu hái zài tíngshuǐ.
dict.en: Our building still has no water.

dict.zh: 師傅正在搶修水管。
dict.py: Shīfù zhèngzài qiǎngxiū shuǐguǎn.
dict.en: The repairmen are rushing to fix the pipes.

dict.zh: 颱風過後，菜價漲了不少。
dict.py: Táifēng guòhòu, càijià zhǎng le bùshǎo.
dict.en: After the typhoon, vegetable prices rose quite a bit.

dict.zh: 聽說下週才會恢復正常。
dict.py: Tīngshuō xià zhōu cái huì huīfù zhèngcháng.
dict.en: They say it won't be back to normal until next week.

dict.zh: 什麼都漲價，只有薪水不漲。
dict.py: Shénme dōu zhǎngjià, zhǐyǒu xīnshuǐ bù zhǎng.
dict.en: Everything's going up in price — except salaries.

pass.zh: 各位住戶請注意：大樓的水管正在搶修，今天晚上八點以前會恢復供水。造成不便，請大家見諒。另外，電梯已經修好了，可以正常使用。

qs.q: When will the water supply be restored?
What has already been fixed?

dict.zh: 明天的參觀流程，今天先演練一次。
dict.py: Míngtiān de cānguān liúchéng, jīntiān xiān yǎnliàn yí cì.
dict.en: We rehearse tomorrow's tour process once today.

dict.zh: 小美在門口負責接待貴賓。
dict.py: Xiǎoměi zài ménkǒu fùzé jiēdài guìbīn.
dict.en: Xiaomei handles receiving the VIPs at the entrance.

dict.zh: 參觀的動線再確認一次。
dict.py: Cānguān de dòngxiàn zài quèrèn yí cì.
dict.en: Confirm the tour route flow one more time.

dict.zh: 最後是無人機的飛行展示。
dict.py: Zuìhòu shì wúrénjī de fēixíng zhǎnshì.
dict.en: Last comes the drone flight demonstration.

dict.zh: 為了安全，展示區請保持距離。
dict.py: Wèile ānquán, zhǎnshì qū qǐng bǎochí jùlí.
dict.en: For safety, keep your distance in the demo area.

pass.zh: 提醒大家，明天董事長十點到。九點半請各單位到自己的位置：小美在門口接待，展示區的設備要提早測試。如果下雨，飛行展示就改到室內用影片說明。

qs.q: Where should everyone be by nine thirty?
What's the backup plan if it rains?
ch: Move indoors and explain the flight with video

dict.zh: 多數工業區今天正式復工。
dict.py: Duōshù gōngyèqū jīntiān zhèngshì fùgōng.
dict.en: Most industrial zones officially resumed work today.

dict.zh: 初步估計農損超過三億元。
dict.py: Chūbù gūjì nóngsǔn chāoguò sān yì yuán.
dict.en: Preliminary estimates put agricultural losses at over three hundred million dollars.

dict.zh: 隨著供應減少，菜價明顯上漲。
dict.py: Suízhe gōngyìng jiǎnshǎo, càijià míngxiǎn shàngzhǎng.
dict.en: As supply falls, vegetable prices are clearly rising.

dict.zh: 政府將加快搶修與重建。
dict.py: Zhèngfǔ jiāng jiākuài qiǎngxiū yǔ chóngjiàn.
dict.en: The government will speed up emergency repairs and rebuilding.

dict.zh: 物價可望下個月回到正常水準。
dict.py: Wùjià kěwàng xià ge yuè huídào zhèngcháng shuǐzhǔn.
dict.en: Consumer prices are expected to return to normal next month.

pass.zh: 午間新聞：颱風白鹿造成的災情持續統計中，農損最嚴重的是南部的香蕉跟芒果。專家提醒，未來兩週菜價還會偏高，建議民眾多買冷凍蔬菜。各科學園區今天全面復工，產能已恢復九成五。

qs.q: Which crops suffered the worst losses?
What has capacity recovered to at the science parks?

scenarios.intro: Post-typhoon price shock at the fruit stand. Your mission: get fruit without paying typhoon prices — mangoes are your friend.

them.zh: 帥哥，來買水果嗎？今天的香蕉很新鮮！
them.py: Shuàigē, lái mǎi shuǐguǒ ma? Jīntiān de xiāngjiāo hěn xīnxiān!
them.en: Hey handsome, here for fruit? Today's bananas are fresh!

turns.task: Ask how much the bananas are.

ans.zh: 香蕉一斤多少錢？
ans.py: Xiāngjiāo yì jīn duōshǎo qián?
ans.en: How much are bananas per catty?

them.zh: 一斤八十，颱風剛過，都是這個價錢啦！
them.py: Yì jīn bāshí, táifēng gāng guò, dōu shì zhège jiàqián la!
them.en: Eighty a catty — the typhoon just passed, that's the price everywhere!

turns.task: Too expensive! Ask about the watermelon.

ans.zh: 太貴了！那西瓜呢？
ans.py: Tài guì le! Nà xīguā ne?
ans.en: Too expensive! What about the watermelon?

them.zh: 西瓜一個兩百，也不便宜喔。
them.py: Xīguā yí ge liǎngbǎi, yě bù piányí ō.
them.en: Watermelons are two hundred each — not cheap either.

turns.task: Ask which fruit is cheaper today.

ans.zh: 今天什麼水果比較便宜？
ans.py: Jīntiān shénme shuǐguǒ bǐjiào piányí?
ans.en: What fruit is cheaper today?

them.zh: 芒果！自己家種的，一斤四十就好。
them.py: Mángguǒ! Zìjǐ jiā zhòng de, yì jīn sìshí jiù hǎo.
them.en: Mangoes! Grown at home — just forty a catty.

turns.task: Great — buy two catties of mangoes.

ans.zh: 好，我要兩斤芒果。
ans.py: Hǎo, wǒ yào liǎng jīn mángguǒ.
ans.en: Great, I'll take two catties of mangoes.

them.zh: 八十塊，謝謝！下次再來喔！
them.py: Bāshí kuài, xièxiè! Xiàcì zài lái ō!
them.en: Eighty dollars, thanks! Come again!

turns.task: Pay, thank her, and say the mangoes look delicious.

ans.zh: 謝謝老闆娘！你的芒果看起來很好吃！
ans.py: Xièxiè lǎobǎnniáng! Nǐ de mángguǒ kàn qǐlái hěn hǎochī!
ans.en: Thanks, boss lady! Your mangoes look delicious!

scenarios.intro: The office survived, mostly. A tree didn't. Split the cleanup jobs and get the place running before the boss arrives.

them.zh: 哇，門口那棵樹倒了！你看到了嗎？
them.py: Wā, ménkǒu nà kē shù dǎo le! Nǐ kàndào le ma?
them.en: Whoa, the tree at the entrance fell! Did you see?

turns.task: You saw — and the ground is covered in trash.

ans.zh: 看到了，地上都是垃圾。
ans.py: Kàndào le, dìshàng dōu shì lèsè.
ans.en: I saw — there's trash all over the ground.

them.zh: 主管說上午大家一起打掃。我們怎麼分？
them.py: Zhǔguǎn shuō shàngwǔ dàjiā yìqǐ dǎsǎo. Wǒmen zěnme fēn?
them.en: Boss says we all clean this morning. How do we split it?

turns.task: He sweeps; you'll tidy the desks.

ans.zh: 你掃地，我收拾桌子。
ans.py: Nǐ sǎodì, wǒ shōushí zhuōzi.
ans.en: You sweep, I'll tidy the desks.

them.zh: 好！欸，這個窗戶怎麼破了？
them.py: Hǎo! Éi, zhège chuānghù zěnme pò le?
them.en: Deal! Hey — how did this window break?

turns.task: Probably the wind last night; you'll call a repairman to fix it.

ans.zh: 應該是昨天晚上的風。我打電話請師傅來修。
ans.py: Yīnggāi shì zuótiān wǎnshàng de fēng. Wǒ dǎ diànhuà qǐng shīfù lái xiū.
ans.en: Probably last night's wind. I'll call a repairman to come fix it.

them.zh: 對了，明天董事長要來，今天一定要弄乾淨！
them.py: Duìle, míngtiān dǒngshìzhǎng yào lái, jīntiān yídìng yào nòng gānjìng!
them.en: Oh right — the chairman comes tomorrow. It HAS to be clean today!

turns.task: No pressure! Say you two can finish before lunch.

ans.zh: 沒問題，我們中午以前可以打掃完。
ans.py: Méi wèntí, wǒmen zhōngwǔ yǐqián kěyǐ dǎsǎo wán.
ans.en: No problem — we can finish cleaning before noon.

them.zh: 太好了！掃完我請你喝咖啡！
them.py: Tài hǎo le! Sǎo wán wǒ qǐng nǐ hē kāfēi!
them.en: Perfect! Coffee's on me when we're done!

turns.task: Accept happily — then get to work!

ans.zh: 好啊！那我們快開始吧！
ans.py: Hǎo a! Nà wǒmen kuài kāishǐ ba!
ans.en: Deal! Then let's get started!

scenarios.intro: The typhoon left your building without water. Find out when it's back, and what the repair crew is actually doing down there.

them.zh: 早安！昨天風雨真的很大，你們家還好嗎？
them.py: Zǎo'ān! Zuótiān fēngyǔ zhēn de hěn dà, nǐmen jiā hái hǎo ma?
them.en: Morning! The wind and rain were brutal yesterday — your place OK?

turns.task: Your place is fine, but you want to ask about the water outage.

ans.zh: 我們家沒事，可是想請問一下，現在還在停水嗎？
ans.py: Wǒmen jiā méishì, kěshì xiǎng qǐngwèn yíxià, xiànzài hái zài tíngshuǐ ma?
ans.en: We're fine — but I wanted to ask, is the water still out?

them.zh: 對，水管被颱風弄壞了，師傅正在搶修。
them.py: Duì, shuǐguǎn bèi táifēng nòng huài le, shīfù zhèngzài qiǎngxiū.
them.en: Yes — the typhoon damaged the pipes; the crew is rushing repairs.

turns.task: Ask when the water will be restored.

ans.zh: 大概什麼時候會恢復供水？
ans.py: Dàgài shénme shíhòu huì huīfù gōngshuǐ?
ans.en: About when will the water supply be restored?

them.zh: 晚上八點以前一定好。今天先用頂樓的水，夠大家用。
them.py: Wǎnshàng bā diǎn yǐqián yídìng hǎo. Jīntiān xiān yòng dǐnglóu de shuǐ, gòu dàjiā yòng.
them.en: By eight tonight for sure. For today we're on the rooftop tank — enough for everyone.

turns.task: Good to know — also mention the elevator was acting strange this morning.

ans.zh: 了解，謝謝。對了，今天早上電梯怪怪的，你知道嗎？
ans.py: Liǎojiě, xièxiè. Duìle, jīntiān zǎoshàng diàntī guàiguài de, nǐ zhīdào ma?
ans.en: Got it, thanks. By the way, the elevator was acting weird this morning — did you know?

them.zh: 已經修好了！早上停電的時候它停了一下。
them.py: Yǐjīng xiū hǎo le! Zǎoshàng tíngdiàn de shíhòu tā tíng le yíxià.
them.en: Already fixed! It stalled during the morning outage.

turns.task: Relieved. Say prices went up everywhere too — what a week.

ans.zh: 那就好。最近什麼都漲價，真是辛苦的一週！
ans.py: Nà jiù hǎo. Zuìjìn shénme dōu zhǎngjià, zhēnshì xīnkǔ de yì zhōu!
ans.en: That's a relief. Everything's gone up in price lately too — what a week!

them.zh: 是啊，菜價最誇張！好了，有問題再來找我。
them.py: Shì a, càijià zuì kuāzhāng! Hǎo le, yǒu wèntí zài lái zhǎo wǒ.
them.en: Tell me about it — vegetable prices are the worst! OK, come find me if anything comes up.

turns.task: Thank him for working so hard after the typhoon.

ans.zh: 謝謝你，颱風過後你們最辛苦了！
ans.py: Xièxiè nǐ, táifēng guòhòu nǐmen zuì xīnkǔ le!
ans.en: Thank you — you all work the hardest after a typhoon!

scenarios.intro: T-minus one day. Xiaomei is walking the reception plan with you, station by station. Tomorrow has to be flawless.

them.zh: 明天十點董事長就到了，我們把流程再走一次好嗎？
them.py: Míngtiān shí diǎn dǒngshìzhǎng jiù dào le, wǒmen bǎ liúchéng zài zǒu yí cì hǎo ma?
them.en: The chairman arrives at ten tomorrow — shall we walk the process once more?

turns.task: Agree — rehearsing once today makes tomorrow smoother.

ans.zh: 好，今天先演練一次，明天才會順利。
ans.py: Hǎo, jīntiān xiān yǎnliàn yí cì, míngtiān cái huì shùnlì.
ans.en: Yes — one rehearsal today, and tomorrow goes smoothly.

them.zh: 我在門口接待，你覺得要準備什麼？
them.py: Wǒ zài ménkǒu jiēdài, nǐ juéde yào zhǔnbèi shénme?
them.en: I'm on reception at the entrance — what should I prepare?

turns.task: Suggest tea, guest badges, and greeting the chairman by title.

ans.zh: 準備茶水跟貴賓證，記得稱呼他董事長。
ans.py: Zhǔnbèi cháshuǐ gēn guìbīn zhèng, jìdé chēnghu tā dǒngshìzhǎng.
ans.en: Prepare tea and VIP badges — and remember to address him as Chairman.

them.zh: 參觀的動線呢？先去哪裡？
them.py: Cānguān de dòngxiàn ne? Xiān qù nǎlǐ?
them.en: And the tour route? Where first?

turns.task: Factory and production line first, then the testing area for the flight demo.

ans.zh: 先看工廠跟生產線，再到測試區看飛行展示。
ans.py: Xiān kàn gōngchǎng gēn shēngchǎnxiàn, zài dào cèshì qū kàn fēixíng zhǎnshì.
ans.en: Factory and production line first, then the testing area for the flight demo.

them.zh: 如果明天下雨，展示怎麼辦？
them.py: Rúguǒ míngtiān xiàyǔ, zhǎnshì zěnme bàn?
them.en: And if it rains tomorrow — what happens to the demo?

turns.task: Backup plan: move indoors and present the flight with video.

ans.zh: 下雨的話就改到室內，用影片說明飛行的部分。
ans.py: Xiàyǔ dehuà jiù gǎi dào shìnèi, yòng yǐngpiàn shuōmíng fēixíng de bùfèn.
ans.en: If it rains, we move indoors and cover the flight portion with video.

them.zh: 完美！那我們明天九點半到位，加油！
them.py: Wánměi! Nà wǒmen míngtiān jiǔ diǎn bàn dàowèi, jiāyóu!
them.en: Perfect! Positions at nine thirty tomorrow — let's do this!

turns.task: Cheer her on — after the typhoon and the rescheduling, tomorrow has to shine.

ans.zh: 加油！颱風都過了，明天一定要讓董事長看到最好的！
ans.py: Jiāyóu! Táifēng dōu guò le, míngtiān yídìng yào ràng dǒngshìzhǎng kàndào zuì hǎo de!
ans.en: Let's go! The typhoon's behind us — tomorrow the chairman sees our best!

scenarios.intro: Monday morning debrief: recovery status, supply-chain readouts, and whether Wednesday's tour is truly green-lit.

them.zh: 早。颱風過後的情況，跟我報告一下。
them.py: Zǎo. Táifēng guòhòu de qíngkuàng, gēn wǒ bàogào yíxià.
them.en: Morning. Give me the post-typhoon rundown.

turns.task: Report: the factory officially resumed work today; power is largely restored.

ans.zh: 工廠今天正式復工，電力也大致恢復了。
ans.py: Gōngchǎng jīntiān zhèngshì fùgōng, diànlì yě dàzhì huīfù le.
ans.en: The factory officially resumed work today, and power is largely restored.

them.zh: 停工那兩天，交期真的沒問題嗎？
them.py: Tínggōng nà liǎng tiān, jiāoqí zhēn de méi wèntí ma?
them.en: Those two days of stoppage — the delivery schedule is truly fine?

turns.task: Confirmed this morning: with the buffer, capacity recovers to ninety-five percent this week.

ans.zh: 今天早上確認過了，加上預留的時間，這週產能可以恢復到九成五。
ans.py: Jīntiān zǎoshàng quèrèn guò le, jiāshàng yùliú de shíjiān, zhè zhōu chǎnnéng kěyǐ huīfù dào jiǔ chéng wǔ.
ans.en: Confirmed this morning — with the buffer time, capacity recovers to ninety-five percent this week.

them.zh: 很好。新聞說南部農損很嚴重，會影響我們嗎？
them.py: Hěn hǎo. Xīnwén shuō nánbù nóngsǔn hěn yánzhòng, huì yǐngxiǎng wǒmen ma?
them.en: Good. The news says southern agricultural losses are severe — does that touch us?

turns.task: Not directly — that's agriculture; but rising prices may lift shipping and material costs slightly.

ans.zh: 對我們沒有直接影響，那是農業的損失。不過隨著物價上漲，運費跟材料可能會貴一點。
ans.py: Duì wǒmen méiyǒu zhíjiē yǐngxiǎng, nà shì nóngyè de sǔnshī. Búguò suízhe wùjià shàngzhǎng, yùnfèi gēn cáiliào kěnéng huì guì yìdiǎn.
ans.en: No direct impact — those are agricultural losses. But as prices rise, shipping and materials may cost a bit more.

them.zh: 了解。明天董事長的參觀，都準備好了？
them.py: Liǎojiě. Míngtiān dǒngshìzhǎng de cānguān, dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le?
them.en: Understood. And tomorrow's chairman tour — fully prepared?

turns.task: Yes — rehearsal done today, route confirmed, rain backup ready.

ans.zh: 都準備好了，今天演練過一次，動線確認了，下雨的備案也有。
ans.py: Dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le, jīntiān yǎnliàn guò yí cì, dòngxiàn quèrèn le, xiàyǔ de bèi'àn yě yǒu.
ans.en: All set — we rehearsed once today, the route is confirmed, and there's a rain backup.

them.zh: 辛苦了。這次颱風處理得很好，明天也拜託你了。
them.py: Xīnkǔ le. Zhè cì táifēng chǔlǐ de hěn hǎo, míngtiān yě bàituō nǐ le.
them.en: Well done. You handled this typhoon well — I'm counting on you tomorrow.

turns.task: Thank him — the team gets the credit; tomorrow you'll show the chairman your best.

ans.zh: 謝謝主管，這是大家一起努力的結果。明天我們一定讓董事長看到最好的一面。
ans.py: Xièxiè zhǔguǎn, zhè shì dàjiā yìqǐ nǔlì de jiéguǒ. Míngtiān wǒmen yídìng ràng dǒngshìzhǎng kàndào zuì hǎo de yímiàn.
ans.en: Thank you — this was the whole team's effort. Tomorrow we'll be sure the chairman sees our best.

x: 颱風過後，水果變貴了。
Táifēng guòhòu, shuǐguǒ biàn guì le.
After the typhoon, fruit got expensive.
vocab.n: 水 water + 果 fruit. 果汁 juice, 果園 orchard. Taiwan is 水果王國 — the Fruit Kingdom — for good reason.

x: 香蕉一斤八十塊，太貴了！
Xiāngjiāo yì jīn bāshí kuài, tài guì le!
Bananas are eighty a catty — too expensive!
vocab.n: 香 fragrant + 蕉. Post-typhoon banana prices are a national talking point — the crop falls over easiest.

x: 夏天吃西瓜最舒服。
Xiàtiān chī xīguā zuì shūfú.
Watermelon in summer is the best.
vocab.n: 西 west + 瓜 melon (it came via the west). 瓜 family: 木瓜 papaya, 苦瓜 bitter melon, 傻瓜 silly melon = fool.

x: 我們買兩斤芒果吧。
Wǒmen mǎi liǎng jīn mángguǒ ba.
Let's buy two catties of mangoes.
vocab.n: 芒果冰 mango shaved ice — Taiwan's summer religion. 愛文芒果 (Irwin mangoes) from Tainan are the famous ones.

x: 我們一起打掃辦公室吧。
Wǒmen yìqǐ dǎsǎo bàngōngshì ba.
Let's clean the office together.
vocab.n: General cleaning; 掃地 is specifically sweeping. 大掃除 = the big Lunar-New-Year deep clean.

vocab.e: to tidy up, put in order
x: 吃完飯，我來收拾桌子。
Chī wán fàn, wǒ lái shōushí zhuōzi.
I'll clear the table after dinner.
vocab.n: Also 'to pack': 收拾行李 pack luggage. Ominously: 收拾你 = deal with you — mom register.

x: 地上都是垃圾。
Dìshàng dōu shì lèsè.
There's trash all over the ground.
vocab.n: Taiwan says lèsè; the mainland says lājī — same characters, instant shibboleth. 垃圾車 plays Beethoven's Für Elise.

x: 窗戶破了，要請人來修。
Chuānghù pò le, yào qǐng rén lái xiū.
The window's broken — we need someone to fix it.
vocab.n: For things that crack or tear: 破了個洞 got a hole. 打破 to smash, 破紀錄 break a record — the good kind of breaking.

x: 颱風一過，菜價就漲。
Táifēng yí guò, càijià jiù zhǎng.
The moment a typhoon passes, vegetable prices jump.
vocab.n: 菜 + 價 price: the post-typhoon headline word. Pattern extends: 油價 fuel prices, 房價 housing prices.

x: 什麼都漲價，只有薪水不漲。
Shénme dōu zhǎngjià, zhǐyǒu xīnshuǐ bù zhǎng.
Everything rises in price — except salaries.
vocab.n: 漲 rise + 價. Opposite 降價. 漲 alone works: 房租又漲了 rent went up again — the universal complaint.

x: 我們這棟樓今天停水。
Wǒmen zhè dòng lóu jīntiān tíngshuǐ.
Our building has no water today.
vocab.n: Completes the 停-utility set with 停電 and 停課. Planned outages get posted as 停水公告 — check before shower plans.

x: 師傅正在搶修水管。
Shīfù zhèngzài qiǎngxiū shuǐguǎn.
The crew is rushing to repair the pipes.
vocab.n: 搶 to rush/grab + 修: repairs against the clock. 搶救 emergency rescue, 搶購 panic-buying — 搶 always means racing time.

x: 小美負責在門口接待貴賓。
Xiǎoměi fùzé zài ménkǒu jiēdài guìbīn.
Xiaomei is in charge of receiving the VIPs at the entrance.
vocab.n: 接 receive + 待 attend to. 接待處 reception desk, 接待人員 reception staff — the front face of every visit.

x: 最後是無人機的飛行展示。
Zuìhòu shì wúrénjī de fēixíng zhǎnshì.
Last comes the drone flight demonstration.
vocab.n: 展 unfold + 示 show: 展示區 demo area, 產品展示 product demo. 展覽 is the full exhibition; 展示 is your demo slot.

x: 參觀的動線再確認一次。
Cānguān de dòngxiàn zài quèrèn yí cì.
Confirm the tour's flow path one more time.
vocab.n: How people move through a space — event planning, retail, factory tours. A word planners use constantly and textbooks skip.

x: 明天的流程，今天先演練一次。
Míngtiān de liúchéng, jīntiān xiān yǎnliàn yí cì.
We drill tomorrow's process once today.
vocab.n: 演 perform + 練 practice. Corporate rehearsals AND military exercises: 軍事演練, 漢光演習 — your industry's double-duty word.

x: 多數工業區今天正式復工。
Duōshù gōngyèqū jīntiān zhèngshì fùgōng.
Most industrial zones officially resumed work today.
vocab.n: 復 resume + 工: the headline that follows every 停工. Sibling: 復電 power restored, 復課 classes resume.

x: 初步估計農損超過三億元。
Chūbù gūjì nóngsǔn chāoguò sān yì yuán.
Preliminary estimates put agricultural losses above three hundred million.
vocab.n: 農業 + 損失 compressed to two characters — classic news shorthand. Every typhoon ends with an 農損 tally by county.

x: 政府希望物價盡快回到正常水準。
Zhèngfǔ xīwàng wùjià jìnkuài huídào zhèngcháng shuǐzhǔn.
The government hopes prices return to normal soon.
vocab.n: 物 goods + 價: 物價上漲 inflation in headlines, 物價指數 the CPI. The macro word above 菜價's street level.

x: 政府將加快災區的重建。
Zhèngfǔ jiāng jiākuài zāiqū de chóngjiàn.
The government will speed up rebuilding in disaster areas.
vocab.n: 重 again + 建 build: 災後重建 post-disaster reconstruction. Read chóng here — the 'again' reading, not zhòng 'heavy'.

x: 颱風過後，香蕉貴桑桑，買不下去。
Táifēng guòhòu, xiāngjiāo guìsāngsāng, mǎi bú xiàqù.
After the typhoon, bananas are stupid expensive — can't bring myself to buy them.
slang.n: Hokkien reduplication that doubles the pain of 貴. The市場 groan-word every post-typhoon week.

x: 好家在我們早就把無人機搬進室內了。
Hǎojiāzài wǒmen zǎo jiù bǎ wúrénjī bān jìn shìnèi le.
Thank goodness we moved the drones indoors early.
slang.n: Hokkien for 'fortunately' — written 好家在 or 好佳哉. The all-purpose disaster-dodged opener, far more common than 幸好 in speech.

x: 窗戶破了，小陳一通電話找到師傅，根本神救援。
Chuānghù pò le, Xiǎo Chén yì tōng diànhuà zhǎodào shīfù, gēnběn shén jiùyuán.
Window broke, Xiao Chen found a repairman with one call — absolute clutch save.
slang.n: 神 god-tier + 救援 rescue. From baseball relief pitching into daily life: anyone who saves the day at the last second.

slang.e: speechless, at a loss for words
x: 香蕉一斤八十塊，我整個無言。
Xiāngjiāo yì jīn bāshí kuài, wǒ zhěngge wúyán.
Bananas at eighty a catty — I'm speechless.
slang.n: 無 without + 言 words: exasperation past the point of commentary. 我對你無言 = I have nothing left to say to you. The deadpan reaction of choice on PTT and in group chats.

x: 颱風走了，合約也快簽了，我們要出運了啦！
Táifēng zǒu le, héyuē yě kuài qiān le, wǒmen yào chūyùn le la!
Typhoon's gone and the contract's nearly signed — our luck is turning!
slang.n: Hokkien 出 exit + 運 fortune: emerging from a bad-luck stretch. The hopeful cousin of 衰 (unlucky) — 你出運了！ your time has come!
